parent_results_already_seen: Station×branch q calibration first synthetic results had 13/48 site-majority certifications under branch-shifted camera q and 48/48 HOLD for branch-pooled q; no genuinely original Uljin wildlife data were seen. This new route is post-parent simulation, not an independent unseen ecological discovery.
target: Same original 96 civil-clock event bins and 41 rising/falling daylength mirror pairs: new independent physical site fixed-trained clock vs astronomy vs season model majority probability, with independently calibrated physical camera detector q varying WITHIN each 41-day photoperiod branch.

day_drift_generator.q_station_branch_source: reuse PR260 physical_site_q(1), the heterogeneous station and season-branch q world, with the SAME 32 physical IID station-type assignments
day_drift_generator.calendar_pair_index: For the 41 preselected mirrored ascending/descending pairs, index j=0..40; calendar days ordered rising_j,falling_j
day_drift_generator.artificial_daily_q: q_site_branch_block_day = qmean + amp*min(qmean,1-qmean)*cos(2*pi*(j+0.5)/41 + block_index*pi/6 + physical_site_type*pi/3), repeated across sixteen original 15-min civil bins of each 4h block
day_drift_generator.q_bounds: 0<qday<1 for all generated site×date×civil blocks; the cosine mean over 41 dates in EACH branch×site×clock block is exactly 0, so the mean across those dates equals qmean
day_drift_generator.sampling_independent_reference_source: Reference for each physical station×season branch×4h civil block samples EACH true passage date iid uniformly among the 41 days of THAT branch and then Bernoulli(q_day). Thus the marginal successes are genuinely iid Bernoulli(qmean) across opportunities, and the 192-cell simultaneous Clopper–Pearson intervals remain correct for the season-MEAN q even when q_day drifts.

external_relative_daily_envelopes.mechanism: Given independent simultaneous CP CI [L_sbg,U_sbg] for the independently sampled station×branch×4h source MEAN q, and an externally guaranteed per-date relative change |qday/qmean - 1|<=eps, the qday clock-group interval is [max(0,L_sbg*(1-eps)), min(1,U_sbg*(1+eps))]. Each original civil 15-min q shares its 4h site×date block value.
external_relative_daily_envelopes.predeclared_external_bound_admission: In this source-free generator, eps>=frozen amplitude is guaranteed conservatively because min(q,1-q)/q<=1 and |cos|<=1. For eps<amp, no independent external certificate is supplied: all corresponding labels HOLD_EXTERNAL_DAILY_DRIFT_CAP_NOT_ATTESTED, regardless of realized oracle true q CI coverage or positive site scores.
external_relative_daily_envelopes.numerical_calendar_date_independence: Shared true q across original 41 dates of a branch is used in the generator; optimize q separately by date for conservative OUTER lower site score bounds, never claim sharp joint 82-date nuisance profile.

simulations.reference_source_rng: EXACT original PR260 calibrated site×branch method 1 at source pattern index 1, with its original frozen reference seed; this is independent of the NEW animal event RNG
simulations.new_animal_rng: NumPy SeedSequence([2026101027, drift_amplitude_index, original_animal_truth_index, events_per_site_date]); source-free original PR260 event data generation is replayed at amp=0 for a strict baseline first-result agreement; only amp=.35 uses this NEW seed.

non_outcome_checks: All 2 amplitudes ×4 eps bounds ×2 external q reference budgets ×3 synthetic animal time truths ×2 event counts ×4 ordered forecast comparisons = 384 complete result rows, without selecting a winner based on outcomes.
All reference q mean samples genuinely iid binomial even under daily q heterogeneity, because sampled day is independently uniform among the same 41 branch dates for EACH true passage opportunity.
Station/branch detector source q must not be silently transported to an individual DATE when daily q drift is possible; eps=0 is valid only in true amp=0 world.
All eps<amp records are predeclared HOLD_EXTERNAL_DAILY_DRIFT_CAP_NOT_ATTESTED and cannot be used as evidence of source-wide detector validity.
Source q oracle actual coverage is AUDIT only. The test must never select favorable calibration outcomes after checking true q was covered.

For eps>=amp, if the true source qmean lies in all CP intervals, the conservatively enlarged date-q envelopes must contain all true station×date×clock-block q values and site score oracle gaps; fail otherwise.

Robust per-site lower score cannot increase as eps increases under the exact same independent reference q and animal events; K and exact significant certification cannot improve when enlarging uncertainty.
The exact source/site error budget is .025+.025=.05 per precommitted site population and four fixed ordered comparisons; do not claim 5% across all 384 artificial worlds.

When amp=0 and eps=0, the frozen parent PR260 station×branch result of 13 certified of 48 original synthetic comparisons must reproduce exactly (same station assignment, independent source samples, animal count seed and trained models).
With 16 IID physical heldout sites, minimum 14 robust positive site scores for exact one-sided Binomial(16,.5) under .00625 per original model pair.
